starting-off.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
starting-off.text: Blooming, thieving, weirdo cultists! Why don't they leave me alone? String 'em all up, that's what I say!

steps.player: What's wrong?

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: It's those blooming cultists from the forest! Those freaks keep breaking into my house!

steps.player: Have they taken much?

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: They first broke in months ago and stole a suit of armour. The strange thing is that they've broken in four times since but taken nothing.

steps.player: And you are...?

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: Why, I am Sir Ceril Carnillean! We really are quite a famous bloodline... who've played a vital role in the politics of Ardougne for many generations.

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: Perhaps you would be able to assist me in returning the stolen armour? For a modest cash reward of course!

options.text: No thanks. I've got other plans.

steps.player: No thanks. I've got other plans.

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: No wonder I'm the one with the big house, and you're the one on the streets.

options.text: Yes, of course, I'd be happy to help.

steps.player: Yes, of course, I'd be happy to help.

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: That's very noble of you sirrah! I caught a glimpse of the thieves leaving but due to... uh.. yeah, my cold I was unable to give chase.

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: They're some kind of crazy cult who dress all in black, and hang out near the cave entrance in the forest south of here.

steps.player: How do you know that?

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: My old butler, Higson, once followed them to their hideout there. Unfortunately the next night he died in his sleep.

steps.player: That's awful!

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: No, it's ok. A replacement arrived the next day. He's been great - cooks an excellent broth!

steps.player: Ok. I'll see what I can do.
You probably deserve it.

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: And who are YOU to judge ME? Hmmm. You look like a peasant anyway. I'm wasting my time talking to you.

options.text: You seem uptight, I'll leave you alone.

steps.player: You seem uptight. I'll leave you alone.

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: Yes, I doubt you could help anyway.

starting-off-talking-to-butler-jones.speaker: Butler Jones
starting-off-talking-to-butler-jones.text: This is the home of Sir Ceril Carnillean of the noble Carnillean family. You're welcome to look around, but I'm afraid I'll have to keep an eye on you.

starting-off-talking-to-butler-jones.speaker: Butler Jones
starting-off-talking-to-butler-jones.text: Recently we've been having a real problem with thieves and strange cultists coming out of the forest for some reason.

starting-off-talking-to-butler-jones.speaker: Butler Jones
starting-off-talking-to-butler-jones.text: Yes, well, these things are bound to happen when you're as wealthy as the Carnilleans.

options.text: Have you any more info on the Carnilleans?

steps.player: Have you any more info on the Carnilleans?

steps.speaker: Butler Jones
steps.text: There's a lot I could tell you about the Carnillean family history. However, I'm afraid if I did speak about such matters I would be at risk of losing my job.

options.text: How long have you worked here?

steps.player: Ok then, take care.

steps.speaker: Butler Jones
steps.text: You too.

starting-off-talking-to-butler-jones-usi.speaker: Claus Carnillean
starting-off-talking-to-butler-jones-usi.text: Oi - I don't want people messing around with my range!

confronting-the-hazeel-cult.speaker: Clivet
confronting-the-hazeel-cult.text: You mind your business, I'll mind mine.

confronting-the-hazeel-cult.player: Look, I KNOW you're hiding something. I've heard theres a cult hideout down here.

confronting-the-hazeel-cult.speaker: Clivet
confronting-the-hazeel-cult.text: If you want to stay healthy you'll leave now.

confronting-the-hazeel-cult.speaker: Clivet
confronting-the-hazeel-cult.text: So... that two faced cold hearted snob has made you fall for his propaganda eh?

confronting-the-hazeel-cult.player: Sir Ceril Carnillean is a man of honour!

confronting-the-hazeel-cult.speaker: Clivet
confronting-the-hazeel-cult.text: Is he now? Is he REALLY? There is a lot more to the Carnilleans than meets the eye you fool...

confronting-the-hazeel-cult.speaker: Clivet
confronting-the-hazeel-cult.text: And none of it is honourable.

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: The Carnillean home does not belong to them. The builder of the house was Lord Hazeel, one of the Mahjarrat followers of Zamorak. Many years ago there was a civil war

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: in this land, and the hateful Saradominists declared war upon all Zamorakians who lived here. Lord Hazeel nobly would not repent his beliefs, and the Carnilleans harrassed

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Hazeel and his followers for many decades. One fateful night, under cover of darkness, they stormed his home in an angry mob torturing and butchering all loyal

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Zamorakians they encountered inside. The following morning, the Carnillean forefathers moved into the empty household and claimed it as their own.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: They have grown fat on the hard work of Lord Hazeel ever since. Unluckily for them Lord Hazeel as a Mahjarrat had access to powers and enchantments they knew nothing

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: about, and made preparations for his return when first they began to storm his home. Soon the day will come when he will return to wreak his vengeance upon the thieves!

steps.player: The politics and histories of Ardougne do not concern me. I have been given a job and intend to see it through to the end.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Well then friend, perhaps I can offer you a different job then? Sooner or later Our master WILL return to this land; those faithful to him will be well rewarded.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Join our cult and assist us in his restoration, and you will be well rewarded; try and prevent his return and suffer the wrath of Zamorak and the Mahjarrat.

options.text: You're crazy, I'd never help you.

steps.player: You're crazy, I'd never help you.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Then you are a fool. Go back to your small minded mundane little life; you will never know the glories you could have tasted as one of us!
The man jumps onto the raft and pushes off down into the sewer system.
Clivet: You'll never find us...

options.text: So what would I have to do?

steps.player: So what would I have to do?

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: You must prove your loyalty to our cause. Killing one of the Carnillean household should be sufficient proof of your dedication to resurrecting our master Lord Hazeel.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: So what say you adventurer? Join our side against the Carnillean thieves?

steps.player: No. I won't do it.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Then you are a fool. Go back to your small minded, mundane little life; you will never know the glories you could have tasted as one of us!

steps.player: Ok, count me in.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Excellent. It takes a rare character to see through the cursed Carnillean lies. I can tell you are a [man/lady] of exactly the right character to join the followers of Hazeel.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Here. Take this poison. Pour it into their food, and once the deed is done, return here and speak to me once more.
Poison (item)

options.text: I've heard enough of your rubbish.

steps.player: I've heard enough of your rubbish!

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Then leave, fool!

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-c.speaker: Clivet
confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-c.text: So. You've returned. Now do you want to know the truth about the 'honourable' Carnilleans?

options.text: I've heard enough of your rubbish.

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-using-the-ra.text: The current is flowing against the raft. It will not move.

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-turning-the-.text: You turn the large metal valve to the right. Beneath your feet you can hear the sudden sound of rushing water from the sewer.
You turn the large metal valve to the left. Beneath your feet you can hear the sudden sound of rushing water from the sewer.

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-sucessfully-.text: The raft washes up the sewer, past the islands until it reaches the end of the sewer passage.

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-a.text: How did YOU get in here?

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-a.player: I've come for the Carnillean family armour. Hand it over, or face the consequences.

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-a.text: I thought I made it clear to the butler you could not be allowed to interfere with our mission. The incompetent fool must be going soft.

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-a.player: So the butler's part of your sordid little cult huh? Why is it ALWAYS the butler? I should have known...

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-a.text: Well you won't live long enough to tell anyone! DIE!!!

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-a.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-a.text: What? Who are you and why did you come here? It doesn't matter, leave now adventurer. While you still can.

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-c.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-c.text: That's SIR Ceril to you, you impudent scamp. Show a bit of respect to your betters. And shouldn't you be recovering my armour?

confronting-the-hazeel-cult-talking-to-c.player: Yeah yeah, I'm on it, I'm ON it.

joining-the-carnillean-side.speaker: Clivet
joining-the-carnillean-side.text: You're more of a fool than you look if you think you will ever find it. When Lord Hazeel is revived you will be first to grovel for his mercy!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: Have you had any luck yet?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.player: Hello Ceril. Yes, I found their hideout.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: SIR Ceril to you. But good work there! BLOOMING good work! Hand over the armour then.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.player: Uh... yeah... about that... I interrogated a cult member at the hideout's entrance, but he managed to escape into the sewer system.
Seems they have some sort of grievance against you and your family. Something about some guy called Hazeel?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: Nope, they're obviously a bunch of blooming loonies! Go find them and bring me back my blooming armour! Nobody steals from Sir Ceril Carnillean!!!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.text: I hope you found those awful hooligan cultists! I simply cannot sleep at night knowing they're loose!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.player: I know, I know, I'm working on it ok?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.text: I don't know, honestly I don't. There are some very odd folk around these parts.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: What? How did you get in here? Who are you and why do you come here? It doesn't matter, you will not live long enough to tell anyone of our hideout!
The Hazeel Cultist attacks the player.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: How did YOU get in here?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.player: I've come for the Carnillean family armour. Hand it over, or face the consequences.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: I thought I made it clear to the butler you could not be allowed to interfere with our mission. The incompetent fool must be going soft.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.player: So the butler's part of your sordid little cult huh? Why is it ALWAYS the butler? I should have known...

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: Well you won't live long enough to tell anyone! DIE!!!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: Out of my way idiot! We are preparing matters your puny mind could not hope to understand!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.player: Uh... I didn't get it yet... I DID find the cult's hideout though!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: Well what are you waiting for? I'm not paying you to blooming sight see you know!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: What? An intruder? HERE? How did you get in here? You must leave! NOW!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Clivet
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: You again! You meddle in our affairs too much! When Lord Hazeel returns to this realm he will lay a mighty vengeance upon you!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.text: Oh, hello again adventurer. I trust you did not have too much trouble dealing with those hooligans?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.player: Nah, it was a piece of cake.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: Yes? You need some help with your quest?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.player: Drop the act Jones. I know you're in league with the cultists.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: W-what? N-no I'm not, don't be silly!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.player: Listen pal, I went to your hideout, I heard them talking about you. You're fooling nobody.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: You think you're so smart don't you? You might think you know what's going on but you have no idea.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.player: I know all I need to know and when I reveal the truth you're going directly to jail.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: Oh, you think so do you? You think that silly old fool Ceril will take YOUR word over MINE? He trusts me completely!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: This is your last warning adventurer: keep your nose out of our business.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Well done! I must say I am very impressed! Come on, hand it over.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Before we send you on your way with your payment, I'll just get Jones to whip you up a batch of his special broth.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.player: I'd rather not if it's all the same to you. I overheard the cultists talking, and apparently Jones is in league with them.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: If the player is on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}:

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: W-what? RIGHT! You! Come with me upstairs! We're going to blooming well sort this out right now once and for all!

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: If the player is on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}:

steps.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
steps.text: W-what? RIGHT! You! We're going to blooming well sort this out right now once and for all!

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Jones! This commoner says you had something to do with the theft of my armour. What do you have to say for yourself about that?

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: It wasn't me m'lud. I am, as you know, a loyal servant.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Humph. Quite right too. I cannot fathom why this scoundrel would accuse you of such a crime without evidence to back up his accusations.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Right. I have decided. I have given my word as a nobleman to reward you for your efforts in retrieving my armour.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: but I must also compensate Jones for this terrible slander you have made against him.
Sir Ceril gives you 5 gold. Sir Ceril gives Jones 1995 gold.

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Now take it and leave you scoundrel! And don't darken my doorstep again!

joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-returning-th.text: Don't worry m'lud, this fool won't be bothering us any more.
Jones smirks at you. You are going to need more than words to prove Jones' treachery.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.text: Hello again adventurer. Still hanging around here eh? I'll be honest, I'm glad someone of your ability is around to assist me in case of trouble.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: I owe you nothing you scoundrel! Now get out or I'll have Jones throw you out!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: Cretin. Did you think you could 'save the day' just by accusing me? We've been planning this for YEARS. your meddling has been nothing more than a minor inconvenience.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: When Lord Hazeel returns, the likes of you and the arrogant Carnilleans will be first to suffer his vengeance.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.player: Not if I can help it!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-b.text: That's basically my point. You cannot help it. Now begone!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.text: You! Don't think you can go accusing our trusted staff and then waltz up to me as though nothing has happened!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.player: Everything I said was the truth.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-h.text: HA! Don't be so ridiculous! Next you'll be trying to tell me Jones murdered our old butler!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.speaker: Alomone
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-a.text: I have no time to waste with the likes of you do-gooder.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.speaker: Clivet
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-c.text: You again. Mark my words meddler; when Lord Hazeel returns you will be punished most severely for your interference in our schemes.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.text: Hello adventurer. I hear you accused Jones the butler of being an accomplice of that loony cult. Is that true?

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.player: That's true, but nobody believes me.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.text: You have my utter faith adventurer. I can't openly defy my employer, Sir Ceril, but I'd like you to know that I think you're on the right track there.

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.player: Hey, thanks! That actually does make me feel a bit better!

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.text: You've already proven to me that you're a law-abiding citizen. Besides, I always found it suspicious that Jones would just show up here on the doorstep the very day after the old butler died in such suspicious

joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-talking-to-t.text: circumstances. Good luck in clearing your name. You have my support.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: You search the cupbaord thoroughly. You find a bottle of poison and a mysterious amulet. You pass your discovery on to Ceril.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: What do you want now you scoundrel?

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.player: Look what I've found in the cupboard!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: You hand Ceril the bottle of poison.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: I... I don't believe it! Poison! JONES!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: You called m'lud?

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: JONES! Just WHAT is this POISON doing here???

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: P-p-poison??? yeah... uh... well, hmm... Oh, it's for Killing rats.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Yes, that's right. Killing rats. I am but a loyal butler sir.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Rats eh? Yes, fair enough. Sorry to have doubted you old boy.
You show Ceril the amulet from the cupboard.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Wh-what??? I've seen this amulet before... The thieves that broke in... One of them was wearing an identical amulet! Jones! I don't believe it!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Jones! We trusted you! We took you into our home!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: You senile old fool... It was all too easy! I should have killed you and your pathetic family weeks ago!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: To think we took you in and trusted you... and this is how you repay us...

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: GUARD!
A Guard rushes into the house.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Take him away. Attempted murder and burglary.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Don't think this is the last you have heard of me Ceril. You and your family will pay dearly for this. GLORY TO HAZEEL! ALL PRAISE ZAMORAK!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Guard
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: Now now. Come along quietly. There'll be no revenge where YOU'RE going - Port Sarim Jail.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: It looks like I am indebted to you sirrah!

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.player: No problem. We all make mistakes.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: But if it weren't for you... My whole family... we could have been... I apologise for my harshness before.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: the very least I can do is to reward you for your noble efforts, and to offer my sincerest apologies as a Lord and gentleman.

joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-carnillean-side-searching-th.text: No, no, thank YOU! Feel free to stop by anytime adventurer!
Quest complete!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-clive.speaker: Clivet
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-clive.text: You have a mission for us adventurer. Go to the Carnilliean household and poison their meal to prove your loyalty.

joining-the-hazeel-side-losing-the-poiso.speaker: Clivet
joining-the-hazeel-side-losing-the-poiso.text: You have a mission for us adventurer. Go to the Carnilliean household and poison their meal to prove your loyalty.

joining-the-hazeel-side-losing-the-poiso.player: I lost the poison you gave me...

joining-the-hazeel-side-losing-the-poiso.speaker: Clivet
joining-the-hazeel-side-losing-the-poiso.text: Useless. Take this and don't mess up this time. Lord Hazeel is depending on you.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-a-haz.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-a-haz.text: Leave me alone, can't you see I'm busy? We have a lot to do preparing for the imminent return of Lord Hazeel

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.speaker: Guard
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.text: Hello. I hear tell you're after that loony cult who broke in the other night. It always gladdens me when civilians assist the law like this.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.text: I hope you found those awful hooligan cultists! I simply cannot sleep at night knowing they're loose!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.text: Humph. You really are useless aren't you?

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.text: More toys! I want MORE TOYS!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.player: Nope, sorry, I don't have sweets either.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.text: I hate you! HATE YOU! Where's my mommy?

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-claus.speaker: Claus the chef
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-claus.text: You're that adventurer the family asked to help get those weird cultists who keep breaking in, right?

joining-the-hazeel-side-using-the-poison.text: You pour the poison into the hot pot. The poison dissolves into the soup.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-claus.speaker: Claus the chef
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-claus.text: Hello there. Caught any of those weird thieves yet?

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.text: No, no I am very far from OK. Those hooligans slaughtered my precious Scruffy! I shall never recover! I am emotionally scarred for life!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-henry.player: It WAS only a dog you know...

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-butle.speaker: Butler Jones
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-butle.text: Hello friend. I heard about your handiwork. Quite amusing really. I'm sure Hazeel will be pleased anyway; Keep up the good work!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-phili.text: Someone killed scruffy. I liked scruffy. He never told me off.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.text: Oh.. the inhumanity... the cruelty.. the misery... the pain... my son is a good boy, really, but how could he give his dinner to Scruffy without having the servants test it for poison first? How? How could he be so

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.text: thoughtless and careless? He knows we are all under threat!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.text: He's been with our family for twenty years... that's 140 in dog years! The poor dog... what did HE ever do to deserve such a fate???

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-ceril.text: I agree! I hope whichever evildoer is responsible gets the full weight of the law brought upon them!

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.speaker: Guard
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.text: Hello. The sarge is furious with me! Apparently those loony cultists have been back somehow without me noticing! I got a right roasting earlier...

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.speaker: Guard
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-the-g.text: I don't exactly know what they got up to in the house... but that's besides the point. Sir Ceril was extremely upset, and I don't blame him.

joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-a-haz.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
joining-the-hazeel-side-talking-to-a-haz.text: Well, it's always good to have a new recruit. Soon we shall retrive Hazeels' scroll and the ritual to revive him can begin!

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.player: I poured the poison into the Carnillean's meal as requested. It didn't quite go to plan however.

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.speaker: Clivet
the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.text: Yes, we heard all about it from one of our sources. Hazeel has eyes everywhere! You have now proved your loyalty and will be rewarded when Hazeel is revived!

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.speaker: Clivet
the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.text: Here. Wear this amulet; it is called The Sign Of Hazeel. Not only will it identify you as one of our brotherhood to other followers but it is also key to finding our hideout.

steps.text: If the player already has Hazeel's mark:

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: But of course, you already knew that, as you already have The Sign Of Hazeel.

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet.text: If the player does not have Hazeel's mark:

steps.player: How does this amulet help do that then?

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Hazeel in his wisdom when he built this lair did so by making it inaccessible unless the flow of the sewers is controlled exactly by the sewer valves above ground.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Each sewer valve must be correctly set before the water level is such that you may enter. The secret of the correct settings is contained in these amulets which honour him.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Starting from left to right, follow the design of the amulet to locate each sewer valve, and then turn each so as to follow the amulet design.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: When you solve the sequence you may enter our hideout where our leader, Alomone, awaits you.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: Well well well... So we have a new recruit. Clivet told me of your desire to join us in our glorious task to resurrect the mighty Hazeel from his slumber.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: To accomplish this, we require the ancient words of summoning which will restore his shattered body, so that he can bring vengeance upon his enemies.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: Hazeel in his mighty cunning anticipated that he might be defeated and secured within his home somewhere a powerful magical scroll that could restore him.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: The words to this powerful enchantment are hidden within the Carnillean mansion, right under the nose of his unsuspecting foes. We already have an agent in place there

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: in their Butler Jones, a faithful follower to Hazeel. His loyalty to Hazeel is beyond questioning, yet he has been unsuccessful in locating the scroll containing the spell so far.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone.text: Go back to the mansion, and assist us in finding this enchantment, so that together we can restore Hazeel to his true power and glory!

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet-again.speaker: Clivet
the-scroll-talking-to-clivet-again.text: Hello once more adventurer. All we need is Hazeels' magical scroll to bring him forth once more to this world.

the-scroll-talking-to-a-hazeel-cultist-a.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
the-scroll-talking-to-a-hazeel-cultist-a.text: Well hello! Until we have retrieved the scroll of Hazeel we cannot resurrect our master. You must find it and bring it to us.

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone-again.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone-again.text: Hazeel has waited long enough to return! It is IMPERATIVE you find that spell!

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone-again.player: Yeah yeah yeah, I'm on it, I'm ON it.

the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard.speaker: Guard
the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard.text: Hello again adventurer. Still hanging around here eh? Let me know if you spot any of those loony cultists sniffing around.

the-scroll-talking-to-ceril.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-ceril.text: Oh cruel world! Scruffy... I knew you well... I... just... don't think I can... go on without...
Sir Ceril breaks down into tears.

the-scroll-talking-to-ceril.player: Loosen up already. It was only a DOG.

the-scroll-talking-to-philipe-again.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-philipe-again.text: Mommy said you're here to kill all the nasty men that keep breaking in.

the-scroll-talking-to-henryeta-again.speaker: Henryeta Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-henryeta-again.text: I'm sorry. I am far too depressed to talk to anybody right now. Oh... poor Scruffy...

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.text: If the player has Hazeel's mark equipped:

steps.speaker: Butler Jones
steps.text: Hello again friend. I see you have the mark now; You should keep it covered up.

steps.player: That? Oh, it's nothing. Just an old amulet.

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.text: If the player does not have Hazeel's mark equipped:

steps.speaker: Butler Jones
steps.text: Hello again friend. I see you decided to keep the mark of Hazeel discreetly about you.

steps.player: Mark of Hazeel? I'm sure I don't know what you mean.

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.speaker: Butler Jones
the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.text: You don't have to pretend with me, friend! Our cause is one and the same; the sooner Lord Hazeel is avenged the better for this city... and for us!

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.player: So do you have any idea where the scroll with the enchantment is?

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.speaker: Butler Jones
the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.text: No idea I'm afraid. I KNOW it's somewhere in this house, but for the life of me I can't find it anywhere. I've searched high and low for it!

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.player: And Sir Ceril doesn't suspect a thing?

the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.speaker: Butler Jones
the-scroll-talking-to-butler-jones.text: Ha! That silly old fool? He can't see the forest for the trees.

the-scroll-talking-to-claus.speaker: Claus the chef
the-scroll-talking-to-claus.text: I... just CAN'T understand it! How? HOW could someone poison my delicious food without me even noticing??? I... I just don't understand!

the-scroll-talking-to-claus.speaker: Claus the chef
the-scroll-talking-to-claus.text: Oh man... I hope I don't lose my job over this... but HOW? How did they do it? And why would the villain want to kill poor Scruffy anyway? He was such a good dog...

the-scroll-talking-to-claus.player: Yeah. It's a real mystery, huh?

the-scroll-searching-the-crate-in-the-ki.text: You search the crate. Under various food package you find an old rusty key.

the-scroll-chest.text: Inside the chest you find the Scroll of Hazeel.

the-scroll-talking-to-jones-after-obtain.text: If the player has the scroll in their inventory:

the-scroll-talking-to-jones-after-obtain.speaker: Butler Jones
the-scroll-talking-to-jones-after-obtain.text: Quick, get it back to our hideout! These are glorious times indeed adventurer, when the mighty Hazeel returns things are REALLY going to change around here!
If the player does not have the scroll in their inventory:

steps.player: Uh... yeah... about that.. I don't exactly have it right now...

steps.speaker: Butler Jones
steps.text: Incompetent fool! The future of our entire plans relies on that scroll! You MUST find it and take it back to our hideout as soon as possible!

the-scroll-talking-to-ceril-after-obtain.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-ceril-after-obtain.text: SIR Ceril! SIR! And I'm not sure but I think the thieves have been back in my house.

the-scroll-talking-to-ceril-after-obtain.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-ceril-after-obtain.text: Well, either I'm going crazy, or theres been an intruder in Jones' room upstairs!

the-scroll-talking-to-philipe-after-obta.speaker: Philipe Carnillean
the-scroll-talking-to-philipe-after-obta.text: Have you got me some toys?

the-scroll-talking-to-philipe-after-obta.player: Gee. I guess I'll just have to live with that then.

the-scroll-talking-to-claus-after-obtain.speaker: Claus the chef
the-scroll-talking-to-claus-after-obtain.text: Those animals... how could they do that to poor Scruffy? What kind of lowlife would do that???

the-scroll-talking-to-claus-after-obtain.player: Get over it, it was only a dog.

the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard-after-ob.speaker: Guard
the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard-after-ob.text: Hello adventurer. I hope you find the cult soon we have a horrible suspicion that there's been another burglary.

the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard-after-ob.speaker: Guard
the-scroll-talking-to-the-guard-after-ob.text: Yes, it is. What's worse is I have no idea how they keep doing it. It's like they do it under my very nose!

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet-after-obtai.speaker: Clivet
the-scroll-talking-to-clivet-after-obtai.text: Have you acquired the enchanted scroll required to resurrect Hazeel yet?
If the player has the scroll in their inventory:

steps.player: Yes, it was in the house all along. Jones can't have looked that hard for it.

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: At last! The pieces are all in place for the glorious resurrection of Lord Hazeel! Now is the starting point for a new page in history, and our chance for vengeance!

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Quickly now! Take the scroll to Alomone so that we may begin the ritual... and when Lord Hazeel returns I promise you that you shall be well rewarded!

the-scroll-talking-to-clivet-after-obtai.text: If the player does not have the scroll in their inventory:

steps.player: Uh... yeah... about that... I seem to have, errm, misplayed it somewhere...

steps.speaker: Clivet
steps.text: Incompetent cretin! Return to the Carnillean household and do not return again without it!

the-scroll-talking-to-a-hazeel-cultist-a.speaker: Hazeel Cultist
the-scroll-talking-to-a-hazeel-cultist-a.text: Welcome back adventurer! Since you have brought us the scroll of Hazeel we can now perform the resurrection ceremony! Soon our master will return!

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone-after-obta.speaker: Alomone
the-scroll-talking-to-alomone-after-obta.text: Have you brought me the scroll of restoration to complete the ritual?
If the player has the scroll in their inventory:

steps.player: Yep. Got it right here.

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: FINALLY! Quickly, give it to me and I will begin the ritual!
You hand Alomone the scroll of Hazeel.

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: Yes... YES! With the words contained within this scroll our Lord shall return to this realm and bring destruction to our enemies!

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: Watch adventurer, and witness the glorious rebirth of Hazeel!

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: Lord Hazeel... Lord Zamorak... I call upon the powers of evil... The forces of chaos... The strength of hatred...

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: Sentente sillaberi junque dithmento! Ia! Ia! dextrimon encanto! termando... imcando... solly enty rando... sentente! Ia! Ia! Indenti zaggarati g'thxa!
Alomone continues to recite the scroll. It is a language you have never heard and do not understand at all.

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: Dintenta! Sententa! Retenta! Q'exjta! Ia! Sottottott! Ia! Dysmenta junque fammatio svelken! Sottey! Sentey! SOLOMENT!
As Alomone finishes reading from the scroll you hear a shrill scream emanate from Hazeel's coffin.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: My loyal followers. I have pride in you all. Never did I expect to return to this land and I see I have much to attend to.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: Soon this world will cower once more at the name Hazeel, and my fury will blaze across mine enemies just as my loyal followers gain their rewards.
Hazeel turns to look at your directly.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: Adventurer. I know that thy efforts were principal in my return to this plane of existence. I offer you my thanks directly.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: You may not be a follower of Zamorak directly but your cunning and treachery mark you as a friend to the Mahjarrat. Rest assured; I will call on your assistance again.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: Weak as I am now, my strength shall return, and my followers will be greatly rewarded when my powers peak once more. Join me in my cause as my servant, and all

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: the riches of this plane shall be yours to share, in domination over all who oppose my kind. You would be wise to pledge yourself now while you still may.

steps.player: I serve nobody but myself.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: Your insolence shall be overlooked this time for I am in truth in your debt. Come close: I shall reward you with wealth such as you deserve.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: Although your true reward will be later, when Zamorak and I, together, lay waste to this miserable planet, and you are spared as an ally to us.
Hazeel gives you some coins. They seem to be extremely ancient.

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: And now I must leave you loyal subjects for time is short, and I have many pressing matters to address before I may make my return. I must leave now, and head Northwards

steps.speaker: Hazeel
steps.text: to join my fellow mahjarrat and regain my strength and powers. I shall return when I am ready to fight my enemies and much blood shall flow across these lands!
Quest complete

the-scroll-talking-to-alomone-after-obta.text: If the player does not have the scroll in their inventory:

steps.player: Nope, sorry.

steps.speaker: Alomone
steps.text: You must find it and bring it to me! Without it we cannot resurrect Hazeel and our efforts to do so will fail!

mfGGw6.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
mfGGw6.text: Have you had any luck yet?

mfGGw6.speaker: Ceril Carnillean
mfGGw6.text: That's SIR Ceril you blooming scoundrel! Show respect when addressing someone of my rank! It's strange you haven't recovered it yet though as Jones seemed quite sure of their location.

mfGGw6.player: Yeah, well, just unlucky I guess.

LZly23.player: How long have you worked here?

LZly23.speaker: Butler Jones
LZly23.text: Long enough to know the Carnilleans are not as innocent or noble as they seem.
